g.title: Before: one manual source, no gate, scattered tables, and silent failures.
One source pulled by hand, so the pipeline only works for one use case.
No schema or quality gate, so bad data lands and breaks downstream tables.
Transforms run by hand in no fixed order, so results are hard to repeat.
Tables scattered with no model, so teams build their own conflicting versions.
Dashboards query raw data directly, so any change breaks them.
No monitoring, so failures are found by users, not by the platform.

svg.text: How it happens, step by step — follow the numbered nodes in order; each step hands its problems to the next.

g.title: After: a gated, governed platform where every project starts from the same blueprint.
APIs, SQL databases, MySQL, files, MFT and SFTP, single or multi-source per use case.
Schema and data quality checks at the gate; failures are quarantined, nothing bad lands.
Glue loads data as-arrived with full fidelity, replayable, nothing lost.
PySpark transformations that join, clean and dedupe, applying business rules once, here.
Clean, conformed, modelled tables, one version of the truth.
Iceberg semantic tables, filtered and promoted, with row, table and field filter packages.
Dashboards on semantic tables for finance, leadership and operations to view and decide.
SQL access, REST APIs and filter packages feeding downstream systems, analysts and ML models.
Airflow orchestration, daily DQ checks, CloudWatch monitoring and alerts, Terraform and CI/CD.
